A grade of C or higher is required for the Public Health Core and Science Requirement. Students who take College: An Introduction ( HSCI 1000 ) and Professional Development for Bouvé Co-op ( HSCI 2000 ) must achieve a C or higher.

overview_text: The combined Bachelor of Science degree program in health science and psychology is designed to provide an interdisciplinary approach to public health and psychology. Through interdisciplinary explorations, students have an opportunity to develop knowledge in health promotion and illness prevention by way of understanding people’s behaviors, perceptions, and emotions within the contexts of relationships and culture. This highly flexible curriculum is enhanced by experiential learning opportunities and is designed to prepare students to practice in interdisciplinary settings and be successful in sustaining and promoting health across populations.
